scenarios.title: Generate expected number of random badge IDs with valid secret and count
given: an event exists with a valid secret (e.g. validsecret123)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs using the valid secret and a count of attendee badge IDs (e.g. 5)
then: the client receives a collection containing exactly the requested count of attendee badge IDs
each generated badge ID in the collection is unique and properly formatted

scenarios.title: Generate a single badge ID using batch endpoint
given: an event exists with a valid secret (e.g. validsecret123)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs using the valid secret and a count of 1
then: the client receives a collection containing exactly 1 attendee badge ID

scenarios.title: Request batch random IDs with an invalid secret
given: an event secret is unknown or invalid (e.g. invalidsecret999)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs with the invalid secret and a positive count
then: the request is rejected with an error indicating the event secret is invalid or unauthorized
no attendee badge IDs are returned

scenarios.title: Request batch random IDs with a non-numeric count
given: an event exists with a valid secret (e.g. validsecret123)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs with a non-numeric count parameter (e.g. abc)
then: the request is rejected with an error indicating an invalid count parameter
no attendee badge IDs are returned

scenarios.title: Request batch random IDs with a negative count
given: an event exists with a valid secret (e.g. validsecret123)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs with a negative count parameter (e.g. -5)
then: the request is rejected with an error indicating an invalid count parameter
no attendee badge IDs are returned

scenarios.title: Request batch random IDs with a count of zero
given: an event exists with a valid secret (e.g. validsecret123)
scenarios.when: the client requests batch random IDs with a count of 0
then: the request is either rejected with a validation error or returns an empty collection of badge IDs without generating attendee badges
